items.description: Forced upgrades can leave obsolete managed skills that still use legacy flow-style requires metadata.
items.analysis: StrictYAML rejects the legacy flow-style dependency list before the marker check can observe specle_group. Existing installations from before this migration may therefore retain obsolete package-managed skills after init --force.
items.recommendation: Accept. Make the marker-only legacy detection tolerant of old frontmatter without weakening schema validation for package-owned metadata.
items.rationale: Marker detection only determines whether an obsolete directory is Specle-managed. Read the frontmatter lines and recognise a line beginning specle_group: without parsing or validating unrelated legacy metadata.

items.description: SCHEMA.md documents a flow-style requires list that the new parser rejects.
items.analysis: The schema contract is now block-list dependencies or an omitted key. Documentation that still presents a flow list would lead maintainers to create invalid managed frontmatter.
items.recommendation: Accept. Update the existing schema documentation to match the supported representation, without adding unrelated workflow detail.
items.rationale: The documented metadata format must match the schema. Keep the correction limited to the existing representation guidance.

items.description: The metadata-parity test does not detect all inventory mismatches.
items.analysis: The test compares only source directory names and omits the active declared name. It should compare the managed active inventory itself while continuing to ignore project-local unmarked skills such as changelog.
items.recommendation: Accept. Strengthen parity coverage around the Specle marker and complete metadata identity.
items.rationale: Parity must compare every managed active skill and its declared metadata identity, while continuing to leave unmarked project-local skills outside the package inventory.

items.description: The obsolete-skill pruning test checks only for removal of SKILL.md.
items.analysis: The installer removes directories, so the test should assert that the whole obsolete directory and an additional contained resource are gone.
items.recommendation: Accept. Make the fixture contain an additional file and assert directory removal.
items.rationale: The installer already removes the directory. The existing test covers marker recognition and removal; broader fixture detail is not worthwhile now and can be reconsidered during a future installer update.
